requirements.title: A compliant reader supports LF and CRLF line endings
requirements.atomic_statement: A VCF-compliant reader supports both LF and CRLF newline conventions.
requirements.condition: When reading VCFv4.3, VCFv4.4, or VCFv4.5 text files.
requirements.required_or_prohibited_behavior: Accept either LF or CRLF as the line-ending convention.
requirements.observable_acceptance_condition: Equivalent valid VCF inputs encoded with LF and CRLF are both accepted without record-content changes.

requirements.title: Line separators occur only at line boundaries
requirements.atomic_statement: Line separator characters are used only as line separators at the end of a VCF line.
requirements.actor: VCF file producer and VCF-compliant reader
requirements.condition: For VCFv4.3, VCFv4.4, and VCFv4.5 text files.
requirements.required_or_prohibited_behavior: Do not embed line-separator characters within a logical VCF line.
requirements.observable_acceptance_condition: Each CR or LF sequence functions only as a logical line boundary; it is not accepted as an in-field character or silently removed from a field.
